# Syllabus, Autumn 2026: Introduction to Data Analysis

Minato University, Faculty of Economics

## 1 Course overview

Instructor: Dr. Emily Hartley, Associate Professor of Economics

Term: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 to Friday, February 5, 2027 (Tuesdays, third period)

Class hours: 90 minutes per session, 15 sessions, 22.5 hours in total

Prerequisite: a pass in Foundations of Statistics

## 2 Weekly schedule

| Week | Topic |
| --- | --- |
| Week 1 | Introduction and the steps of an analysis |
| Week 2 | Collecting and cleaning data |
| Week 3 | Frequency tables and histograms |
| Week 4 | Mean, median and variance |
| Week 5 | Scatter plots and correlation |
| Week 6 | Simple regression |
| Week 7 | Reading a regression table |
| Week 8 | Midterm review and exercises |
| Week 9 | Multiple regression |
| Week 10 | Dummy variables |
| Week 11 | Time series data |
| Week 12 | Samples and estimation |
| Week 13 | Hypothesis testing |
| Week 14 | Reporting an analysis |
| Week 15 | Course review |

## 3 Examination

The final examination is on Tuesday, February 2, 2027, third period, in Room 201 of Building 3.

## 4 Grading

Grades are based on the following weights.

| Component | Weight |
| --- | --- |
| Final examination | 50% |
| Written assignment | 30% |
| Participation | 20% |

## 5 Assignment

Submit the written assignment through the learning system by Friday, January 29, 2027.

## 6 Questions

Ask questions after class, or during Dr. Emily Hartley's office hours (Wednesdays, 12:00 to 13:00) in Room 412 of Building 3.

To ask by email, put the course name in the subject line and write to Dr. Emily Hartley.
